# Gateway Down Syndrome Association

> > Gateway DSA provides comprehensive Down syndrome support, family resources, and community programs for Eastern Missouri and Southern Illinois.

Gateway Down Syndrome Association (Gateway DSA) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting individuals with Down syndrome and their families in the St. Louis region and surrounding areas. The organization offers family support groups, educational workshops, community events, and peer resources to help families navigate Down syndrome.

## Key Topics

- Down syndrome
- Family support
- Support groups
- Community events
- Parent resources

## Getting Started & Core Information

- [HOME](https://gatewaydsa.org): Gateway DSA homepage for Down syndrome support in Eastern Missouri and Southern Illinois
- [ABOUT Gateway DSA](https://gatewaydsa.org/about/gateway-dsa): Gateway DSA organizational mission, values, and service history
- [About Down Syndrome](https://gatewaydsa.org/about/down-syndrome): Educational resource on Down syndrome genetics, Trisomy 21, and chromosomal information
- [ABOUT Gateway DSA](https://gatewaydsa.org/about): About Gateway DSA mission, staff, and organization overview

## Family Support & Resources

- [FAMILY SUPPORT](https://gatewaydsa.org/family-support): Family support resources, groups, and workshops for Down syndrome families
- [New and Expectant Parents](https://gatewaydsa.org/resources/new-and-expectant-parents): Resources and support for parents new to Down syndrome diagnosis
- [Support Groups](https://gatewaydsa.org/family-support/support-groups): Support groups for parents and caregivers on regression, dementia, and challenges
- [Sharing Our Strategies](https://gatewaydsa.org/sharing-our-strategies): Parent peer support and advice sharing for Down syndrome family strategies
- [Workshops](https://gatewaydsa.org/workshops): Gateway DSA workshops on financial planning, ABLE accounts, and family skills

## Events & Community

- [Gateway DSA Calendar](https://gatewaydsa.org/calendar): Calendar of Gateway DSA events, programs, support groups, and Zoom links
- [Family Events](https://gatewaydsa.org/events/family-events): Family events and celebrations including World Down Syndrome Day activities
- [Belonging](https://gatewaydsa.org/events/belonging): Belonging photography exhibit by Randy Bacon showcasing Down syndrome community

## Get Involved

- [DONATE](https://gatewaydsa.org/donation): Donate to Gateway DSA to support Down syndrome services in St. Louis region
- [Volunteer](https://gatewaydsa.org/volunteer): Volunteer opportunities with Gateway DSA for community event and program support

## News & Updates

- [Gateway DSA Blog](https://gatewaydsa.org/blog): Blog posts by parents, individuals with Down syndrome, and staff on education and support
- [Gateway DSA Newsletter](https://gatewaydsa.org/newsletters): Gateway DSA newsletters, membership updates, and community news archives
